title: spergularia marginata subsp. angustata
intro: Spergularia marginata subsp. angustata, commonly known as a type of sand-spurrey, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce inflammation and protect the body against oxidative stress. The plant is also reported to exhibit therapeutic actions, including sedative and antispasmodic properties, which may help to calm nervous tension and relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Spergularia marginata subsp. angustata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
